```python
Signature(input_tree: Any = None, output_tree: Any = None, input_specs: tuple[Any, ...] = (), output_specs: tuple[Any, ...] = (), static_values: tuple[Any, ...] = (), output_static_values: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
```

Part of [`evoxc.backends`](/api/evoxc/backends/)

Input/output contract recorded at `lower()` time, passed down from the Graph.

## Attributes

- `input_tree` · `Any` — `core.TreeSpec` of the structured input (flatten/unflatten).

- `output_tree` · `Any` — `core.TreeSpec` of the structured output.

- `input_specs` · `tuple[Any, ...]` — per-leaf `core.TensorSpec` in flattened input order.

- `output_specs` · `tuple[Any, ...]` — per-leaf `core.TensorSpec` in flattened output order.

- `static_values` · `tuple[Any, ...]` — Python values the trace specialized on (input static
  leaves, in pre-order leaf order); validated at run time (changing
  them means a different graph — never a hidden recompile).

- `output_static_values` · `tuple[Any, ...]` — Python values recorded for static OUTPUT leaves
  (in pre-order leaf order), re-inserted by `evoxc.run` when
  reconstructing the structured outputs.
